developer-tooling.title: Adopt OmniEngineering workspace and Headroom context optimization
developer-tooling.description: Install the OmniEngineering .ai/ scaffold and ./omni CLI so assistant sessions share one loading order, ruleset and requirements registry; install Headroom's Claude Code integration at local scope so tool output is compressed through the local proxy.
acceptance_criteria: python omni doctor reports only the known upstream gaps listed in .ai/project-configuration.md
.claude/settings.local.json carries the Headroom env and hooks and is git-ignored
risk_notes: No pristine OmniEngineering upstream is available locally; the scaffold was assembled from STEP-Migration copies, so .ai/adapters/, .ai/checklists/public-release.md, fallback-llm-rules.json and hci-ui-rules.json are absent
With Headroom routing enabled, Claude Code sessions in this repo depend on the local proxy on port 8787 being reachable
